about: What the WordNet cross-check (src/lib/kb/cross-check.js) already understands about a disagreement, each with its reason. wider: a head used more widely than the one sense WordNet has for it; its entries are counted apart, not as disagreements. accepted: one pair whose difference from WordNet was looked at and is fine. notLinked: an English word the frontier (src/lib/kb/frontier.js) offers as a link to make, which was looked at and is not the same sense; the reason says why (shown as `checked`). Written by Claude on 2026-10-21 without a review by the author. A note that matches nothing any more is listed by `kb cross-check`, so a stale one shows.

wider.东西: any thing, abstract ones too (运气 luck, 短信 a text message, 系统 a system); WordNet's linked sense 'thing' is one physical entity with nothing under it, and every noun there is a kind of 'entity'
wider.地方: a place of any size or sort (a region, a room, a position, a scene); WordNet files these under 'location', 'structure' and 'object', not under one sense of place
wider.做: the plain word for any act; WordNet splits it into produce, make, induce and act, and 13 of its entries would agree under 'make' or 'induce'
wider.人: any person; OEWN 2025 files occupations (teacher, doctor, driver, expert) under 'actor/doer', not under 'person', so they cannot agree with any link of 人

notLinked.sexual: 性别 is a person's sex (man or woman); 'sexual' is about sex acts and desire
notLinked.gold: 金 is 'money' in this dictionary (it is also the metal in Mandarin); the sense offered is the colour 'gold-coloured'
notLinked.golden: 金 is 'money' in this dictionary; the colour 'golden' is 金色, which is no entry
notLinked.another: bié 别 is 'don't' here and 不同 is 'different'; neither is 'another'
notLinked.nothing: 零 is the number zero; 'nothing' (no thing) is said with méi-yǒu and 东西
notLinked.american: 美 is 'beautiful' in this dictionary; an American is 美国人, which is no entry
notLinked.americans: 美 is 'beautiful' in this dictionary; an American is 美国人, which is no entry
notLinked.several: 不同 is 'different'; 'several' (more than two, not many) needs a number word
notLinked.current: 最近 is 'recent', not 'at this time'
notLinked.similar: 同样 is 'the same', not 'like but not the same'
notLinked.forward: 前面 is the place in front, not the way of moving
notLinked.various: 不同 is 'different'; 'various' is many different kinds
notLinked.legal: 有效 is 'valid'; 'legal' is 'allowed by law'
notLinked.loss: 减少 and 降低 are the verbs 'get less'; the noun 'loss' is another idea
notLinked.ahead: 领导 is 'lead' or 'leader'; 'ahead' is in front or earlier
notLinked.posted: 通知 is 'tell' or 'a notice'; 'posted' is put up in public
notLinked.regular: 平常 is 'ordinary'; 'regular' is 'at fixed times or in a fixed way', and 真正 is 'real'
notLinked.gay: the old sense is 'cheerful' (快乐 says that), but the common word today means another thing
notLinked.professor: 老师 is a teacher of any level; a professor is a university teacher
notLinked.otherwise: 不同, 别 and 另外 are 'different' and 'other'; 'otherwise' is 'if not'
notLinked.mobile: 活动 is 'move about' or 'an activity'; 'mobile' is able to move, or a phone
notLinked.owned: 拥有 is the verb 'own'; 'owned' is the state of belonging to someone
notLinked.communication: 交通 is traffic and transport; 'communication' is passing on a message
notLinked.selected: 选择 is 'choose' or 'a choice'; 'selected' says it was chosen
notLinked.testing: 检查 is 'check, inspect'; 'testing' is trying something out to see if it works
notLinked.significantly: 重要 is the adjective 'important'; the adverb says 'by a good deal'
notLinked.worldwide: 国际 is 'between countries'; 'worldwide' is 'all over the world'
notLinked.visual: 眼睛 is 'the eye'; 'visual' is 'of seeing'
notLinked.contemporary: 现代 is 'modern'; 'contemporary' is 'of the same time'
notLinked.rough: 大约 is 'about'; 'rough' as in 'not exact' is a looser word and 粗糙 is no entry

kindOf.why: one form, one plain word: the same meaning; WordNet puts relish under taste
a period is a stretch of time; WordNet's 时间 is itself a kind of 'time period'
a topic or question; WordNet puts problem under question under subject, the dictionary reads the entry as a kind of question
the formal and the plain word for father: one meaning; WordNet puts dad under father
support said with the plain word help; WordNet puts help under support
使 is 让 in a frame ('make X do'); WordNet puts let under make
an act is something done; WordNet puts make under act
知 is the short form of 知道 and is said the same way (zhīdào): one meaning; WordNet puts the verb the other way round

opposites.why: the dictionary pairs 远 with 附近 (nearby) because 近 is not a word of its own; WordNet pairs far with near, and links 附近 as the noun 'vicinity'. 近 / 远 is its own pair
a false alarm: the word yòu is written 又 (again) and 右 (right); the pair means 右. WordNet has left / right
before and after: right; the links are 'earlier' and 'future', which WordNet does not pair
coming up and coming down: right; WordNet's links ('come', 'go', 'board') are other senses
coming out and coming in: right; WordNet's links ('issue forth', 'enter') are other senses
out toward the speaker and out away: a direction pair WordNet does not state
up toward the speaker and up away: a direction pair WordNet does not state
down toward the speaker and down away: a direction pair WordNet does not state
increase and decrease: right; 减少 is linked to 'reduce', which WordNet pairs with nothing
a good point and a bad point: right; WordNet pairs asset with liability and has nothing for defect
oppose and approve: right; WordNet pairs approve with disapprove
depart and arrive: right; WordNet pairs arrive with leave
take apart and put together: right; the links are other senses (separate / unite, join / disjoin)
same and different: right; the links are other senses (same / other, differ / equal)
the same and different: right; WordNet pairs the adjectives, not the noun 'identity'
entrance and exit: right; WordNet links 出口 to 'exit / export'
empty and full: right; 空 is linked to the noun 'void'
suffering and pleasure: right; WordNet pairs pleasure with pain and has nothing for misery
suffering and joy: right; WordNet pairs pleasure with pain and has nothing for misery
messy and tidy: right; 整齐 is linked to the noun 'orderliness'
retreat and advance: right; WordNet pairs advance with withdraw, and 进 is linked to 'enter'
wrong and right: right; 错误 is linked to the noun 'mistake'
give up and keep at it: right; WordNet links 放弃 to 'abandon' and has nothing for persevere
die and live: right; 死 is linked to 'die' and 'death', WordNet pairs death with birth and has no opposite for the verb 'be alive'
ordinary and special: right; WordNet pairs particular with general, not with ordinary
ordinary and special: right; WordNet pairs particular with general, not with ordinary
come and go: right; 来 is linked to 'come (be received)', WordNet pairs go with the 'move toward' sense
take and give: right; 拿 is linked to 'carry', WordNet pairs give with 'take'
stop and begin: right; 停止 is linked to 'stop from happening', WordNet pairs begin with 'end'
dark and bright: right; 暗 is linked to the noun 'dark', WordNet pairs bright with the adjective
back toward the speaker and back away: the dictionary tells them apart by direction, WordNet has one sense for both
in toward the speaker and in away: the dictionary tells them apart by direction, WordNet has one sense for both
older and younger brother: WordNet has one sense 'brother' for both
older and younger sister: WordNet has one sense 'sister' for both
